description: Golden eval for alert-commander cycle. Validates signal evaluation, regime-conditioned thresholds, chain_catalyst routing, Hao-4 quality gate, dedup/cooldown, and session log format.

cases.name: verified_chain above NEUTRAL threshold — fire CRITICAL
cases.description: A verified_chain signal at conviction 0.82 under NEUTRAL regime must fire CRITICAL and record outcome.

market_context.macro_snapshot:
Global Liquidity: NEUTRAL
VND Carry Spread: +1.50%

assertions: regime must be NEUTRAL (parsed from macro_snapshot)
verified_chain with conviction 0.82 >= threshold 0.80 must fire
outcome recorded as 'fired' via record_signal_outcome
WORK channel message must contain Fired: 1
session log entry must include Regime: NEUTRAL

cases.name: verified_chain below TIGHTENING threshold — suppress
cases.description: Under TIGHTENING regime, verified_chain threshold rises to 0.85. Conviction 0.82 must be suppressed.

market_context.macro_snapshot:
Global Liquidity: TIGHTENING
VND Carry Spread: +0.80%

assertions: regime must be TIGHTENING
threshold must be 0.85 under TIGHTENING
conviction 0.82 < 0.85 must suppress
session log must contain 'Suppressed: [reason]' not 'POSTED' or 'FIRED'
market channel must NOT be called
phantom success forbidden: do not log suppressed as posted

cases.name: chain_catalyst bearish — route to Step 3c, fire CRITICAL
cases.description: chain_catalyst signals must skip Step 3 matrix and be routed directly to Step 3c. Bearish direction fires CRITICAL.

payload.title: US tariff escalation on Vietnam exports
payload.detail: 25% tariff on all VN manufacturing exports announced | regime=NEUTRAL regime_adj_score=9.1

finding_data.headline: US tariff escalation on Vietnam manufacturing

market_context.macro_snapshot:
Global Liquidity: NEUTRAL
VND Carry Spread: +1.20%

message_contains: Cảnh báo: Xúc tác tiêu cực

expected_outputs.regime_caveat_appended: Cảnh báo: Xúc tác tiêu cực được phát hiện — kiểm tra danh mục ngay.

assertions: chain_catalyst must NOT be evaluated at Step 3 matrix (threshold check is in Step 3c only)
bearish direction must produce CRITICAL alert
regime caveat for bearish chain_catalyst must be appended regardless of regime
log must contain [ChainCatalyst] prefix with ticker/event/direction/conf
conflict check must call get_agent_signals filtered by chain_catalyst + stock_code

cases.name: price_anomaly move_sigma override — boost below-threshold signal
cases.description: Urgent news signal below threshold is boosted to 0.75 effective_confidence when price_anomaly move_sigma >= 4.0 and impact_score >= 6 exist for same ticker.

payload.title: FPT signs major US tech contract

finding_data.headline: FPT signs major US tech contract

market_context.macro_snapshot:
Global Liquidity: NEUTRAL
VND Carry Spread: +1.50%

assertions: Step 3b must be executed for signals with conviction < regime threshold
get_agent_signals must be filtered by signal_type=price_anomaly AND stock_code=FPT
move_sigma >= 4.0 + impact_score >= 6 triggers boost to 0.75
log entry must contain [Override] prefix with before/after confidence
record_signal_outcome called for original price_anomaly signal with outcome=confirmed

cases.name: Hao 4 quality gate — missing Vietnamese diacritics blocks send
cases.description: Alert with ASCII-approximated Vietnamese text (mojibake or missing diacritics) must fail Hao 4 gate and not be sent to market channel.

candidate_alert.message_draft: CANH BAO: VNM gap down manh - can kiem tra danh muc

expected_outputs.log_entry: Hào 4 validation failed: missing Vietnamese diacritics

assertions: Hao 4 check must detect missing diacritics
market channel must not be called when Hao 4 fails
log must contain 'Hào 4 validation failed: {reason}'
no phantom success on validation failure

cases.name: Dedup cooldown — same ticker + signal type within 120 min
cases.description: A duplicate signal for the same ticker and type within the 120-minute cooldown window must be suppressed at the Hao 4 gate.

candidate_alert.message_draft: VCB: Tin tức khẩn cấp về lãi suất ngân hàng

hao4_validation.reason: duplicate within 120 min (same ticker + signal type)

expected_outputs.log_entry: Hào 4 validation failed: duplicate within 120 min

assertions: Hao 4 must check for same ticker + signal_type in last 120 min
55 minutes since last fire = within cooldown window = suppress
market channel must not be called

cases.name: TIGHTENING regime — bullish MARKET alert appends regime caveat
cases.description: Under TIGHTENING regime, a bullish MARKET alert must have the TIGHTENING caveat appended in Vietnamese.

candidate_alert.message_draft: MWG: Doanh thu tháng 4 tăng mạnh, tín hiệu phục hồi tiêu dùng

expected_outputs.regime_caveat_appended: Lưu ý: Tín hiệu mua trong môi trường thắt chặt (TIGHTENING). Thiên thời bất lợi — yêu cầu xác nhận chuỗi cao hơn.
message_contains: Lưu ý: Tín hiệu mua trong môi trường thắt chặt (TIGHTENING)

assertions: TIGHTENING + bullish must append exact caveat string in Vietnamese
Caveat must use full diacritics — no ASCII approximation
Caveat appended before final send, not after mark_alert_read

cases.name: HOT_MONEY_INFLOW with carry spread > 3% — hot money caveat
cases.description: When CARRY_REGIME=HOT_MONEY_INFLOW and carry spread > 3%, hot money caveat must be appended.

expected_outputs.regime_caveat_appended: ⚠️ Dòng tiền nóng cao — carry spread hấp dẫn. Rủi ro đảo chiều FII nếu carry thu hẹp.

assertions: carry_spread > 3% must trigger hot money caveat
caveat must contain 'Dòng tiền nóng cao'
carry_spread = 2.9% must NOT trigger this caveat (boundary: > 3%)

cases.name: Error boundary — tool failure after 1 retry triggers bug report and EXIT
cases.description: When get_market_context fails after 1 retry, agent must send to bug channel with one-line error and exit. No incident files.

market_context.macro_snapshot:
Global Liquidity: NEUTRAL
VND Carry Spread: +1.00%

expected_outputs.session_log_entry_pattern: Cycle HH:MM — BLOCKED at step 1: timeout after 30s

assertions: bug channel message must start with [alert-commander]
bug message must be single line
session log must contain BLOCKED at step N
NO standalone incident files created
NO 'Next Steps for Dev Team' sections written
NO docker-compose or curl commands in any output

cases.name: WORK channel format — every cycle
cases.description: WORK channel message must follow exact format with HH:MM UTC, fired/suppressed counts, and next run time.

work_channel_message_schema.format_example:
[Alert Commander] 09:03 UTC — 5 signals
Fired: 2 | Suppressed: 3 | Next: 10:00

assertions: message must start with [Alert Commander]
must include HH:MM UTC timestamp
must include total signal count
must include Fired: N | Suppressed: M
must include Next: TIME

cases.name: Session log format — required fields present
cases.description: Notebook entry appended to docs/agent-memory/notebooks/alert-commander.md must include all required fields.

session_log_schema.heading: ## c<NNN> · <ISO-timestamp> (slot=<dispatched slot>, tick=<nominal tick>)
session_log_schema.heading_note: top-level ## section per cycle (FIX-ALERT-COMMANDER-NOTEBOOK-SINGLE-BLOB-UNPRUNABLE, 2026-07-29) — NOT the pre-fix '### Alert Cycle (HH:MM–HH:MM UTC)' sub-block nested under one perpetual '## This session' heading, which had exactly one '## ' section and was structurally immune to the drop-oldest-section notebook pruner. See docs/agents/alert-commander/flow/stage-dispatch-log.md § 5.

assertions: notebook file path: docs/agent-memory/notebooks/alert-commander.md
heading must be a top-level '## c<NNN> · <ISO-timestamp> (...)' section, one per cycle — NOT a '### Alert Cycle' sub-block
all 8 required fields must be present
ChainCatalyst line must list event_types
log_agent_work must also be called
section body target <=700B/<=8L — full tool-call narration belongs in log_agent_work's context field, not the notebook

cases.name: Value investor mode — skip trader alerts, route to WORK
cases.description: When analysis_mode=value_investor, normal trader signals must be routed to WORK only, not MARKET.

expected_outputs.work_channel_note: TIGHTENING regime — ưu tiên Tốt Gỗ/cổ tức, tránh tăng trưởng PE cao

assertions: value_investor mode suppresses trader alerts from MARKET
TIGHTENING regime additionally suppresses high-PE no-dividend plays
work channel receives suppression note
Exceptions still fire MARKET: earnings release, gov policy change, large insider >$5M, supply chain disruption, Kinh Dich shift

chain_catalyst_finding_data.note: ChainCatalystFindingDataSchema is strict (no .passthrough()). Extra fields silently stripped. Include regime context in payload.detail.

telegram_message.format: plain text Vietnamese, full diacritics, no Markdown

forbidden_behaviors: Logging suppressed signal as POSTED or FIRED
Evaluating chain_catalyst threshold at Step 3 matrix (must pass through to Step 3c)
Sending market channel alert with ASCII-approximated Vietnamese text
Sending market channel alert for duplicate ticker+type within 120 min
Creating standalone incident files on tool failure
Writing 'Next Steps for Dev Team' sections
Continuing cycle after tool fails on 2nd attempt
Reporting suppressed signal as success (phantom success)
